scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/mock-swiggy dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit --project apps/api/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project apps/mock-swiggy/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/shared/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit --project packages/db/tsconfig.json && echo 'All typechecks pass'
scripts.ci:local: bun run test:unit && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && bun run check:maps && gitleaks detect --no-banner
